title: Import a folder of Markdown or MDX posts into the newsroom
description: Backlog. A papyrus ops command that imports Markdown/MDX files with front matter (title, description, date, author, tags) as published items, keeping their slugs so existing URLs keep working. First user: the five dataparade.io landing posts. Gherkin to be written when picked up.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Not needed: Papyrus already has 'papyrus ops content import-markus' (PPY-22a3b4), which imported the Data Parade posts (PPY-e19725). The only MDX-specific step was turning the author object into a string, done by hand.
